item.title: The Millionaire Who Secretly Filmed His Attacks On Women
item.description: Wealthy Japanese property developer Joji Obara was convicted of sexually assaulting multiple women and causing the death of Australian Carita Ridgway. Investigators also found hundreds of recordings involving drugged women. He was later convicted of abducting and disposing of Lucie Blackman’s body and is serving life in prison.

item.title: She Invented A Road Rage Killer To Hide The Truth
item.description: Tracie Andrews claimed her fiancé, Lee Harvey, was killed by a stranger during a road-rage attack in 1996. Investigators dismantled her story, and she was convicted of his murder the following year and sentenced to life in prison.

item.title: She Hired A Hitman To Kill Her Ex’s New Girlfriend
item.description: Brenda Delgado was convicted of orchestrating the 2015 murder of Dallas dentist Kendra Hatcher, who was dating Delgado’s former boyfriend. Prosecutors said Delgado recruited a gunman and getaway driver, then fled to Mexico. She was convicted of capital murder and sentenced to life without parole.
